capacity_by_date.type: object: ISO calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) -> nonnegative integer in the resource's declared unit

date_timezone.calendar_resources: The timezone of the resource's own calendar (calendar.timezone). 'project' calendars use the project timezone.
date_timezone.continuous_resources: The project timezone (resources with availability 'continuous' have no calendar of their own).

capacity_by_date.date_span: From local midnight of the date to local midnight of the next date in that timezone, half-open. On DST transition days the span is 23 h or 25 h, never a fixed 24 h.
capacity_by_date.effect: Replaces the declared capacity for every tick inside the span. Calendar availability still governs working-time occupancy; continuous reservations are checked across the whole span, including capacity changes inside a reservation interval.
constraints: Date keys must be canonical ISO dates; values nonnegative integers (rates use the m3/h unit, scaled exactly with nominal and drawn rates).
Span boundaries must align to the scheduling tick (TICK_MISALIGNED otherwise).
An explicit-none resource may only declare 0.
The resource must declare a unit compatible with its class.
Duplicate date keys are invalid input.

worked_examples.case: Working-time resource whose calendar is in Europe/London (project in Europe/Madrid)
Continuous reusable asset (no calendar): project timezone Europe/Madrid, spring DST day
Continuous reusable asset: autumn DST day

acceptance_additions.requirement: Override span uses the resource calendar timezone
acceptance_additions.pass_condition: Europe/London resource override for 2027-03-29 applies from 2027-03-28T23:00Z to 2027-03-29T23:00Z

acceptance_additions.requirement: Continuous resources use the project timezone and DST-length days

acceptance_additions.pass_condition: non-ISO keys, negative/fractional values, missing unit, explicit-none > 0, duplicate keys -> MODEL_INVALID
